profile.headline: Scrum Master / Software Engineer at The Boeing Company
profile.summary: Accomplished Software Engineer with over a decade of experience in designing and implementing scalable, high-performance software solutions for diverse industries. Expert in driving full-cycle software development, from requirements analysis to deployment, while fostering cross-functional collaboration and mentoring junior developers. Committed to leveraging innovative technologies to deliver robust, user-centric applications that enhance business efficiency and drive growth.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Software engineer on a Modernization scrum team, where we are working on migrating AT&T applications to the MS Azure framework as a part of AT&T's larger Cloud Modernization effort. In addition, I am working on building a CI/CD pipeline for a new modernization chatbot that will assist the modernization scrum teams as they migrate to the MS Azure framework.
